class SoccerManagementTest(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.soccer_system = SoccerSystem()
        self.team1 = Team('Team1', ['Alice', 'Bob'])
        self.team2 = Team('Team2', ['Eve', 'Mallory'])
    
    def test_register_teams(self):
        self.soccer_system.register_team(self.team1)
        self.soccer_system.register_team(self.team2)
        
        self.assertListEqual(self.soccer_system.teams, [self.team1, self.team2])

    def test_create_match(self):
        self.soccer_system.create_match(1, self.team1, self.team2, True)
        
        expected_match = Match(1, self.team1, self.team2, True)
        self.assertListEqual(self.soccer_system.matches, [expected_match])
    
    def test_match_results_draw(self):
        self.soccer_system.create_match(1, self.team1, self.team2, True)
        
        self.soccer_system.matches[0].set_score(0, 1)

        self.assertEqual(self.team1.points, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.team2.points, 0)
